posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform Anthropic Said to Postpone IPO to Just Before Midterms PYMNTS · 🟧 Claude · 5h ago • Anthropic postponed its IPO to late October, delaying the prospectus release originally expected in early September. • The timing aligns with midterm elections, suggesting strategic consideration of market and political conditions. • The AI company remains on track for a public offering despite pushing back the timeline. 🤖 AI Platform How Far Are China's Humanoids From a Real 'ChatGPT Moment'? Pandaily (China) · 🟢 ChatGPT · 🌏 Asia · 22m ago • China leads humanoid robot manufacturing but lacks the key milestone of task generality achieved through voice commands alone. • Analysts consider true progress achieved when robots can perform approximately 80% of novel jobs based on voice input. • Current demos and exports, while significant, don't yet represent a transformative AI breakthrough equivalent to ChatGPT's moment. 🤖 AI Platform Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI Simon Willison · 🟢 ChatGPT · 2h ago • OpenAI is focused on Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) as a path toward AGI development. • Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki published an essay discussing this research acceleration direction. • RSI represents a core strategic shift in OpenAI's current research priorities. 📰 Also covered by: OpenAI News Read more →
